topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by connecting histopathology practical observations to cellular transformation and outlines the lecture's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Oncogenes and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established the laboratory assays used to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional Classes of Cancer Genes and Mutation Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and related functional categories, detailing how specific mutations affect cell cycle control and multimeric protein function.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the distinctions between chromosomal and sequence instability by detailing the specific DNA repair failures and mitotic defects that cause them.

topics.label: Multistep Carcinogenesis and Hereditary Cancer Predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the stepwise accumulation of mutations driving tumor development and explain how inherited germline mutations accelerate this progression and influence tumor evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with a recap of learning outcomes, a book recommendation, and a preview of the next lecture.
